name: Jahdo
title: Descendant of Gad
summary: Jahdo was a man from the tribe of Gad, son of Bus. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as part of the Gadite families who lived in Gilead and Bashan. He is part of the genealogical overview of the tribes of Israel in the books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Gad's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jahdo is listed as the son of Bus in the genealogy of the tribe of Gad, as part of the genealogical overview in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Gad in Gilead
keyEvents.description: Jahdo belonged to the tribe of Gad that lived in the region of Gilead and Bashan. The tribe's territory lay east of the Jordan River.

keyEvents.title: Abihail's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Jahdo was part of the lineage of Abihail, son of Huri, who was one of the heads of the Gadite families.

keyEvents.title: The Settlement of the Gadites
keyEvents.description: Gad's descendants, including the family of Jahdo, settled in Gilead, Bashan, and the surrounding towns, with pastureland in Sharon.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical records during Jotham and Jeroboam
keyEvents.description: The genealogies mentioning Jahdo were recorded during the time of Judah's king Jotham and Israel's king Jeroboam II.
